deliverables: Full-stack open-source payments infrastructure for Cardano
Connection to banking rails, stablecoin systems, and wallet interfaces
Visa card issuance linked directly to onchain balances
WP1 - Enabling Onchain Payments & Card Infrastructure
request.recipient: Intersect-administered 2026 Treasury Reserve Smart Contract stake address stake1784sdxt6jjennmstphgdu7l7c2scf5d02a6cve2dgn5s2kq5u3j9v, submitted by Intersect on behalf of the vendor Wirex.
request.what: Treasury withdrawal to fund Bringing Real-World Payments to Cardano with Wirex.

claims.claim: The proposal requests 3,961,538 ada, consisting of 3,846,153 ada for WP1 and 115,385 ada for the Intersect Budget Administration fee.
Wirex proposes to deliver open-source payments infrastructure including smart contract engineering, account abstraction, batched transactions, settlement logic, and wallet and API ecosystem layers.
The proposed solution would enable Visa card issuance linked directly to onchain balances so users can spend digital assets globally at millions of merchants.
Wirex claims proven execution capability through 7 million users, more than 1.5 million cards issued, more than $20 billion in transaction volume, and Visa Principal Member experience.
The proposal achieved the required 67% support threshold during the 2026 Intersect Budget Process Hydra Voting phase.
The requested withdrawal does not, at submission time, alone or in aggregate, breach the 350M Net Change Limit covering Epoch 613 to Epoch 713.
Audit, administrative oversight, reporting obligations, and milestone-based disbursement controls are included through Intersect and technically capable third parties.

Treasury funds would be routed through the 2026 Treasury Reserve Smart Contract and a Project-Specific Smart Contract using stated multi-party authorization thresholds involving Intersect admins, Intersect leadership, and six external oversight entities.
The proposal says Wirex has not received ada from the Cardano Treasury within the last 24 months.
A Sundae treasury dashboard and on-chain records are presented as mechanisms for community auditing and tracking of the withdrawn ada.

summary: The document requests 3,961,538 ada for a Wirex payments infrastructure initiative administered through Intersect smart-contract tooling, with claims of real-world payment adoption, open-source infrastructure, Intersect budget-process approval, NCL compliance, and oversight controls.
